# NetSuite CPQ Proposal Generator

NetSuite CPQ Proposal Generator (8 pages): NetSuite CPQ Proposal Generator

## Chapters
- [NetSuite CPQ Proposal Generator](article_5132447427.md): Note: NetSuite CPQ Proposal Generator requires NetSuite CPQ Configurator to create documents from transactions.
  - [NetSuite CPQ Proposal Generator Setup](article_1133208531.md): Before creating documents, define settings on the options record at CPQ Proposal Generator Settings.
  - [Creating Document Templates](article_1134727908.md): With NetSuite CPQ Proposal Generator, you can create templates to outline the document structure and store the content of your documents.
  - [Creating Documents from Transactions](article_93712689.md): Users can create documents from saved transactions.
